preconditions.description: The sizes of permutations a and b must be within the specified bounds.
The lengths of permutations a and b must match the specified sizes n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and all(1 <= x <= m for x in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutation a must be distinct integers from 1 to n, and all elements in permutation b must be distinct integers from 1 to m.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of distinct integers d such that the modified sequence c is a subsequence of b.
